removed_from_floor.reason: False positive: the 76 'thrust' hits are vehicle-physics engine thrust variables (physxvehicle, ovphysx vehicle schema), not the Thrust library; no Thrust/CUB use anywhere in the tree.

planner_notes: blast/ and flow/ carry no CUDA (blast: one forward-declaration comment; flow: D3D12/Vulkan compute shaders), so nothing in them is ported; they are built by premake and produce no components here.
Generated against upstream main 7d6f6ac8 (PhysX 5.13.0), the tree moat-port merges; the AMD rocm-enablement base is 5.10.0 (4f2103c3).
